tw-ia-state-center-stage-kettle.t: The 1868 Newton robbery was of the Jasper County treasurer's safe (about Feb 1868), one of five Iowa county treasuries robbed in five weeks; two suspects were arrested in Chicago by Pinkerton men and jailed at Newton in March 1868. No period paper gives the sum, so the $40,000-50,000 of the legend is unsupported.
